svg.title: Orion Mesh
svg.desc: Two Raspberry Pis on NixOS, joined by a BATMAN-adv mesh, measure how much an H.264 stream on the same Wi-Fi channel delays 50 Hz ROS 2 control messages. Both SD images build from one flake. Pictures: The testbed: both nodes, the shared radio link, the message that is timed and the video loads tested.

text.tspan: Two Raspberry Pis on NixOS, joined by a BATMAN-adv mesh, measure how much an H.264 stream on the same Wi-Fi
channel delays 50 Hz ROS 2 control messages. Both SD images build from one flake.

svg.text: Ad-hoc Wi-Fi cell, bridged by BATMAN-adv
Latency is the ground's receive time minus the send time.
Each trial also records sequence gaps and CPU use.
